question: At what location must air be placed, and in what manner should it be drawn, according to this prescription?
premises: Air is to be taken as the object.
It must be placed at the root of the tongue and palate.
Having done so, it should be drunk slowly.
inference: One should place air at the root of the tongue and palate and drink it slowly.
uncertainties: The purpose of this practice is not stated in this verse.
plain_english: Having placed air at the root of the tongue and palate, one should drink it slowly.
